thread:
ara_support: FYI — customer 'Craftly' reporting a spike of 502/504 during a campaign at 11:03 UTC, user-facing timeouts. They gave a sample request_id: req_0a1b2c3d.
emily_sre: On it. Can you paste the request_ids and the tenant id?
ara_support: tenant craftly-prod, sample reqs: req_0a1b2c3d, req_4d3c2b1a. They said it started ~ 10:58 and lasted ~ 6m.
lucas_runtime: I pulled the gateway trace for craftly-prod around that window — saw backlog + long queue times then 502s from the pool. Looks like scale-up didn't add pods quickly.
jonathan_eng: Any KEDA/HPA logs? Was KEDA not firing or were pods stuck in init?
emily_sre: grabbing k8s events now. Quick note: our infra metrics (active_replicas) show a drop to 0 for ~30s right before the spike. That seems odd.
ops-bot: [alert] autoscale: craftly-prod pool scaled from 2 -> 0 at 10:56:14 due to metric source returning 0.
ara_support: Wait scaled down to 0? Customer said they had continuous traffic.
lucas_runtime: That explains it — if pool goes to 0 and then KEDA takes time to wake, requests pile up and gateway times out. Why did metric return 0?
jonathan_eng: Checking metric exporter logs — seeing intermittent 403s to metric-scraper around token refresh. Looks like billing service rotated a token at 10:55 and the scraper lost access for ~20-40s. When exporter returned 0, KEDA thought there was no work and scaled down.
emily_sre: Repro snippet from exporter logs:
```
2026-03-17T10:55:12Z ERROR exporter auth: token refresh failed 403
2026-03-17T10:55:32Z WARN metrics: returned empty series
2026-03-17T10:55:45Z INFO exporter auth: token refreshed
```
jonathan_eng: That's concerning — token rotation should be seamless. billing-bot: FYI we rotated per schedule at 10:55 but there was a transient permission gap on the metrics role due to propagation lag.
billing-bot: There was a short window where new token wasn't granted metrics:read on the role binding; fix deployed at 10:56.
elimy_sre: (typo) emily_sre: Thanks. So sequence: billing rotation -> metric-scraper 403 -> metric returns 0 -> KEDA/HPA scales pool to 0 -> traffic causes coldstart and gateway 502/504s while pods provision.
ara_support: Customer impacted for ~6m, understandably angry. They supplied some logs showing gateway 504s.
lucas_runtime: Immediate mitigation: raise minReplicas for craftly-prod pools to 2 and add a short-lived emergency annotation to disable KEDA to avoid further scale-to-zero while we patch auth. I'll run the helm patch.
jonathan_eng: Also adding a guard in our scaler: treat a single short zero-point as noise if preceding metric > 0 within last 60s. Prevents aggressive scale-to-zero on transient scrapes. Will draft PR.
emily_sre: Applying mitigation now:
```
kubectl -n prod patch hpa craftly-prod-pool --type=json -p '[{"op":"replace","path":"/spec/minReplicas","value":2}]'
kubectl -n prod annotate deployment craftly-prod scale.keda.sh/enabled=false --overwrite
```
ops-bot: [action] patched minReplicas -> 2 and annotated to disable keda at 10:59. Pods starting.
ara_support: Customer notified about temporary mitigation and that we are investigating root cause. They want ETA for full fix.
billing-bot: We've rolled back the rotation policy change that caused the propagation gap and queued a policy to include metrics:read into pre-rotation checks.
jonathan_eng: Follow-ups: (1) PR to scaler debounce (2) add liveness for metric-scraper to retry on auth 403 with backoff and circuit-break to maintain last-known-good metric value for short windows (3) add alert that triggers if pool scales to 0 while recent request rate > threshold.
ellucas_runtime: also recommend longer warmup for coldstart model variants — increase kube readiness timeout and add faster image prefetch for hot tenants.
emily_sre: Creating incident ticket INF-2026-482 with timeline, mitigation, and customer impact. Will include logs and pod events.
ara_support: Customer asked for temporary credits for downtime — forwarding to CS.
jonathan_eng: ETA on PR for debounce is ~4 hours, will try to fast-track. I'll open a hotfix branch and assign reviewers.
ops-bot: [note] suggest adding an autoscale runbook step: when auth rotation is scheduled, temporarily pin minReplicas >0 for critical tenants during rollout.
billing-bot: Agree. We'll coordinate next rotation with ops and vet role bindings.
ara_support: Thanks team. Any blockers?
emily_sre: Nothing blocking now. We'll monitor dashboards for 30m and update customer in 1h.
ara_support: closing loop with customer and marking as high priority until fix. :thumbsup:
